name: XANNIBAN
description:
About This Game

ENTER XANNI-CORP

Awaken beneath in XANNIBAN, a point-and-click driven action-horror shooter that blends strategic planning with quick reflexes. Take control of the Trespasser, a vessel tasked with finding an important figure within the depths of a rogue corporation's underground facilities.

CONTAIN ROGUE MACHINES

Use your wits to lure, counter, and trap adaptive enemies. Navigate your way through sprawling facilities filled with traps and hazards as you lead threats into their containment.

UTILIZE YOUR TOOLKIT

Make your way through the chambers of XANNI-CORP using various tools. Bring foes to you and deflect attacks with your flare-gun, break through passageways and block enemy strikes with a caliper, and discover more equipment deep within the corporation's premises.

MANAGE LIMITED RESOURCES

Keep track and maintain resources for both your tools & the facility's systems. Gain ammo through finding spare flares, use items discovered in each sector to make progress & keep the facility's power running, and closely monitor your limited vitals.

FEATURES

  • CAMPAIGN: Survive dark facilities filled with hazards, traps, and obstacles. Fight and contain threats as you unearth a sealed away epidemic.

  • UNIQUE GAMEPLAY: XANNIBAN blends point & click controls with dungeon-crawler movement. Dash between rooms and continuously adapt to your environment & nearby enemies. Route your path through dynamic level elements, and plan your moves. 

  • RESOURCE MANAGEMENT: Keep a close eye on limited flare-gun ammo, tool durability & sector power. Fuel the facility's generators to keep various systems & lights powered on - or struggle in darkness.

  • ABILITIES & PERKS: Empower your vessel with abilities and perks, constructed in The Hub from scrap you obtain through combat encounters.

  • HUB: Return to a safe space after beating a level to upgrade your equipment, equip tools & view player stats.

  • SCORES & TIMES: Compete against other trespassers for the best times and scores on level leader-boards, viewable within the pause menu. 

  • CONTROLS: Use fast & simple controls on multiple input methods:

    • Keyboard & Mouse (adapts to layout)

    • Controller

    • Mouse Only
short_desc: Point & click to survive the complexes of XANNI-CORP - plan, lure and adapt in this action-horror shooter as you seal away rogue machines.
